newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish keeps 52-wk T-bill min price flat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Polish keeps 52-wk T-bill min price flat at tender.

text.p: Poland kept the minimum price of the 52-week T-bill flat at 81.85 at Thursday's primary auction, accepting just 100 million zlotys of the 929 million worth of bids placed at the tender, the finance ministry said.
The maximum price was 81.87, down from 82.20 on Monday.
Poland will offer 300 million zlotys worth of 13-week, 200 million of 26-week and 600 million 52-week T-bills next Monday, as earlier scheduled.
